title: Microsoft Teams: Facilitator Protection skill warns of suspected social engineering
summary: The briefing accurately distinguishes the roadmap target from Microsoft's tenant-facing rollout schedule. Its licensing, default state and Facilitator controls are supported, and it clearly identifies the Protection-specific details Microsoft has not documented.

claims.where: title; front matter: products
claims.claim: This roadmap item concerns the Facilitator Protection skill in Microsoft Teams.
claims.quote: "products": ["Microsoft Teams"]; "When Facilitator is in your meeting, its Protection skill uses AI to check the meeting transcript"

claims.where: summary; What's changing; Risk assessment; rationale: risk
claims.claim: The Protection skill uses AI to check the meeting transcript.
claims.quote: When Facilitator is in your meeting, its Protection skill uses AI to check the meeting transcript for signs of possible social engineering.

claims.where: summary; What's changing; Risk assessment
claims.claim: The skill looks for suspected attempts by outsiders to trick participants into sharing sensitive information.
claims.quote: Facilitator can help you spot suspected attempts by people outside your organization to trick you into sharing sensitive information during a meeting.

claims.where: What's changing; Risk assessment; rationale: impact
claims.claim: Users see a warning in the meeting if a suspected attempt is detected.
claims.quote: If it detects a suspected attempt, you'll see a warning in the meeting

claims.where: What's changing; Risk assessment; rationale: impact
claims.claim: The warning offers users an option to end the meeting.
claims.quote: Users will have options to end the meeting or temporarily restrict information sharing.

claims.where: What's changing; Risk assessment; rationale: impact
claims.claim: The warning offers users an option to temporarily restrict information sharing.
claims.quote: Users will have options to end the meeting or temporarily restrict information sharing.

claims.where: What's changing; Why it matters; Risk assessment; rationale: risk
claims.claim: The Protection skill is invoked automatically when Facilitator is present in a meeting with outside participants.
claims.quote: When Facilitator is present in a meeting with participants outside your organization, the Protection skill is invoked automatically.

claims.where: front matter: defaultState; summary; What's changing
claims.claim: The Protection skill requires no administrator action to enable it, supporting defaultState on for its intended meetings.
claims.quote: No action is required to enable the Protection skill.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Change & support; Governance guidance
claims.claim: Microsoft recommends informing users about suspected-social-engineering warnings.
claims.quote: Inform users that they may receive warnings about suspected social-engineering attempts during meetings with external participants.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Change & support; Governance guidance
claims.claim: Microsoft recommends helping users understand the available warning options.
claims.quote: Help users understand the available options if a warning appears.

claims.where: What's changing
claims.claim: Microsoft Learn does not yet describe the Protection skill itself.
claims.quote: Searched: Facilitator "Protection" skill social engineering settings license warnings retention processing. Opened learn.microsoft.com/microsoftteams/facilitator-teams and learn.microsoft.com/purview/ai-teams-facilitator; neither describes Protection.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure; Open questions
claims.claim: Microsoft has not specified where the Protection skill's transcript analysis runs.
claims.quote: Searched: "Facilitator" "Protection skill" "retention" "processing". Opened Learn's facilitator-teams, ai-teams-facilitator and microsoft-365-copilot-privacy; general privacy commitments do not identify the Protection analysis implementation.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure; Open questions
claims.claim: Microsoft has not specified whether Protection warnings are retained.
claims.quote: Searched: "Facilitator" "Protection skill" "retention" "processing". Opened learn.microsoft.com/purview/ai-teams-facilitator and microsoftteams/facilitator-teams; general interaction retention is documented, but Protection warnings are not identified.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Autonomy & actions
claims.claim: Microsoft has not described what the Protection warning's restrict-information-sharing option changes.
claims.quote: Searched: "Facilitator" "Protection" "restrict information sharing". Opened learn.microsoft.com/microsoftteams/facilitator-teams and purview/ai-teams-facilitator; read roadmap and MC1536056. The option is named without its mechanics.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Change & support; Governance controls; rationale: risk
claims.claim: No Protection-specific setting is documented in the supplied roadmap or notice or found in the searched administration documentation.
claims.quote: Searched: "Facilitator" "Protection skill" "disable" "PowerShell"; Facilitator Protection skill Teams PowerShell Microsoft Graph disable. Read roadmap, MC1536056, Learn's facilitator-teams and update-m365teamsapp; no Protection-specific setting found.

claims.where: Risk assessment; Governance guidance; Governance controls; Open questions
claims.claim: Microsoft has not explicitly confirmed how blocking the Facilitator app affects the Protection skill.
claims.quote: Searched: "Facilitator" "Protection skill" "disable" "PowerShell". Read MC1536056 and learn.microsoft.com/microsoftteams/facilitator-teams; the notice requires Facilitator presence, but neither explicitly describes blocking's effect on Protection.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Autonomy & actions; Governance guidance
claims.claim: Facilitator is allowed by default for otherwise eligible meetings.
claims.quote: Facilitator is allowed by default. However, if all apps are blocked for your organization, Facilitator is also blocked.

claims.where: controls[0].ui; Governance guidance; Governance controls
claims.claim: The Facilitator app can be allowed or blocked in Teams admin center under Teams apps > Manage apps > Facilitator > Allow or Block.
claims.quote: In the left rail navigation, select Teams apps > Manage apps. ... Select Facilitator from the app list. ... In the actions menu, select Allow or Block.

claims.where: controls[0].api; Governance controls
claims.claim: MicrosoftTeams PowerShell documents Update-M365TeamsApp -Id <app-id> -AppAssignmentType Everyone to update an app's availability to Everyone.
claims.quote:
Update-M365TeamsApp -Id 4c4ec2e8-4a2c-4bce-8d8f-00fc664a4e5b -AppAssignmentType Everyone
Updates the availability value for Bookings app (App ID 4c4ec2e8-4a2c-4bce-8d8f-00fc664a4e5b) to Everyone.

claims.where: controls[0].note; Governance controls
claims.claim: Update-M365TeamsApp is documented for app-state management.
claims.quote: This cmdlet allows administrators to modify app state, availability and installation status by adding or removing users and groups or changing assignment type or installation status.

claims.where: controls[0].note; Governance controls
claims.claim: The reference describes an example using -IsBlocked $true as unblocking an app.
claims.quote:
Update-M365TeamsApp -Id 4c4ec2e8-4a2c-4bce-8d8f-00fc664a4e5b -IsBlocked $true
Unblocks Bookings app (App ID 4c4ec2e8-4a2c-4bce-8d8f-00fc664a4e5b).

claims.where: controls[0].note; Governance controls
claims.claim: The reference also describes its -IsBlocked $false example as unblocking an app.
claims.quote: Example 4 ... -IsBlocked $false ... Unblocks 1Page App (App ID 2b876f4d-2e6b-4ee7-9b09-8893808c1380) and updates installation setting for the app to include 3 users and 1 group.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.model and notes; Cost and licensing; rationale: cost
claims.claim: Facilitator features in Teams meetings are included with a Microsoft Copilot license.
claims.quote: Facilitator is included with a Microsoft Copilot license and subject to available capacity. The following list contains the prerequisites for users to be able to access Facilitator features in Teams meetings.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing
claims.claim: Facilitator's inclusion is subject to available capacity.
claims.quote: Facilitator is included with a Microsoft Copilot license and subject to available capacity.

claims.claim: Learn lists an eligible Microsoft 365 base licence as a Facilitator user requirement.
claims.quote: Users must meet all of the following requirements: ... An eligible Microsoft 365 base license.

claims.where: Cost and licensing
claims.claim: Learn lists an eligible Microsoft Teams licence as a Facilitator user requirement.
claims.quote: Have an eligible Microsoft Teams license.

claims.where: Cost and licensing
claims.claim: Learn lists a Microsoft Copilot licence as a Facilitator user requirement.
claims.quote: Have a Microsoft Copilot license.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing; Open questions
claims.claim: Microsoft has not published which participants need licences specifically to receive Protection warnings.
claims.quote: Searched: "Facilitator" "Protection skill" "license" "prerequisites". Opened learn.microsoft.com/microsoftteams/facilitator-teams and microsoft-365/copilot/microsoft-365-copilot-licensing; read MC1536056. No Protection-warning recipient licence rule found.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing; Open questions; rationale: cost
claims.claim: No Protection-specific additional charge is published.
claims.quote: Searched: Microsoft Copilot licensing Facilitator meetings included capacity Protection skill charges; Facilitator Protection skill Teams billing. Opened Learn's facilitator-teams and microsoft-365-copilot-licensing; no separate Protection charge found.

claims.where: Scope: Users
claims.claim: Only licensed users can initiate Facilitator.
claims.quote: Only licensed userscan initiate Facilitator.

claims.where: Scope: Prerequisites
claims.claim: Loop experiences in Teams must be turned on for Facilitator in meetings.
claims.quote: Have Loop experiences in Teams for Facilitator in meetings turned on.

claims.where: Scope: Prerequisites
claims.claim: Additional Protection-specific prerequisites are not published.
claims.quote: Searched: "Facilitator" "Protection skill" "license" "prerequisites". Opened learn.microsoft.com/microsoftteams/facilitator-teams; read roadmap and MC1536056. Facilitator presence and external participants are stated, but no additional prerequisites.

claims.where: What's changing; Scope: Limitation to confirm; Open questions
claims.claim: Learn currently says Facilitator is not supported in external chats and meetings.
claims.quote: Currently, Facilitator isn't supported in 1:1 chats, group chats, or external chats and meetings.

claims.where: Governance controls
claims.claim: Learn describes app permission policies for allowing Facilitator to selected users.
claims.quote: Follow the instructions at Use app permission policies to control user access to apps to create a new app policy for Facilitator.

claims.where: Governance controls
claims.claim: Learn describes app-centric management for assigning Facilitator availability to groups of users.
claims.quote: You can then assign the policy to your entire tenant or to a select group of users. Follow the instructions at Add or modify app availability for users to assign the policy to users using app-centric management.

claims.where: Governance controls
claims.claim: The documented Facilitator app-setting steps use Teams admin credentials.
claims.quote: Sign in to the Teams admin center with your Teams admin credentials.

claims.where: controls[0].scope and governs; Governance controls
claims.claim: The app-availability control can govern Facilitator across the tenant, rather than being documented as a separate Protection switch.
claims.quote: As an admin, you control whether Facilitator is available to your entire organization or to a certain group of users.

claims.where: front matter: cost; Cost and licensing; rationale: cost
claims.claim: The documented incremental cost is indirect administrative and communication work, with Facilitator included in its existing Copilot licence.
claims.quote: Facilitator is included with a Microsoft Copilot license and subject to available capacity.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Security & identity
claims.claim: The roadmap describes a warning with user response options, not an automatic blocking action.
claims.quote: If it detects a suspected attempt, you'll see a warning in the meeting, with options to end or to temporarily restrict information sharing.
